_note: Airstriker ships with stable-retro. Its sound plays a constant delay after each frame's flip; --no-audio mutes it. fps is this Genesis core's native rate: the session stops a block whose sound per step does not match 1/fps.
_keys_note: Genesis buttons for this core are 0=B, 1=A, 2=MODE, 3=START, 4=UP, 5=DOWN, 6=LEFT, 7=RIGHT, 8=C, 9=Y, 10=X, 11=Z and 'keys' values are those indices (held keys combine). Airstriker uses the D-pad to move and B to fire, so the map below is arrows + X (keyboard) -> B (console). The controls the subject sees are a plain 'message' phase; keep its text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

curriculum.text: Airstriker: arrows move, X fires; ESC quits.
